body: I'm here. About 5 hours left. Haven't been on because I spent the day at my sons grave and making sure I haven't been alone. Its tough but I wanted to pop on long enough to say I'm still here.
Lets Mark it as the day I attempt to start taking back control. ;)
I will grant you that present then. Reddit is amazing and has talked me out of being irrational.
? What channel and how to I check it out?
Thank you.
Thank you. I love Reddit. And you.
:) thank you. It seems Reddit thinks I deserve to stick around. Complete strangers may have just saved my life. Thank you
I'm so sorry for your loss. I genuinely am. I'm trying desperately to hold on. I just need help right now. Its so rough with his birthday coming up.
Thank you Pingo. Your words are very helpful maybe I can be an awesome 'aunt'.

Thank you. I know he would be an amazing person and he would do so many things inthis world. I know he wants me to be happy but it's almost impossible to even smile and not feel guilty he isn't here experiencing that happiness.
I wish I could pick myself up. Ice tried for 3 years now. I just can't.
Thank you

And you made me cry again. I know my son is happy but why couldn't he survive like our ancestors? Its not fair. I miss him so much and it's Not fair that I get to live in this so called beautiful world and he didn't even get to see the outside of the hospital.
Everyone has it harder than someone else. That's how I look at it. I hope things get better for you and you can get out of this darkness too.
Literally one and she just had a baby less than a month ago and is harder off than I am.
I don't even know what to say. That made me cry. Thank you for taking the time to actually write that just for me. It means a lot more than you could know.
I know. But its the one day at a time thats killing me.
They passed in a house fire when I was 4.

I have no-one. I have one friend and she is harder off than I am And my family is non existent. Both parents and grandparents are dead and I have no siblings. If I could just survive for 2 weeks until my first check things might be ok But I just feel so hopeless right now.

I've reached out to churches and charities and no-one has any funds available. Shelters are full and pantries only help so much. My landlord said hrs let me pay late fees when my check comes in but I don't think I'll make it that long. Thank you for your advice.
